remarks: Exceptional Orchard Park living awaits in this beautifully designed home, where sophisticated details meet everyday living. A two-story foyer sets the tone, leading to an elegant formal dining room with stylish glass doors opening to the kitchen. The well-appointed kitchen is designed for gathering, featuring a generous center island, buffet bar, and adjoining wet bar with beverage chiller. A convenient door from the kitchen leads directly to the expansive backyard featuring a spacious partially covered patio, generous grilling area and stunning gunite in-ground pool. The golf enthusiast will appreciate the private tee box and putting green where you can perfect your game creating an ideal setting for outdoor entertaining. The inviting living room showcases beautiful architectural accents and a warming gas fireplace, while the first-floor includes an office with built-ins and laundry room adding to the home's thoughtful functionality. The second level offers an owner's suite with a sitting area and spa-like bathroom featuring a luxurious jetted tub. Three additional bedrooms along with a bonus room provide ample space for family and guests. The finished lower level elevates the entertainment experience with a theater area, theater seating, and bar. A three-car garage provides exceptional storage and convenience. Located within the highly regarded Orchard Park School district this home offers many extras with an exceptional blend of elegance, comfort, and entertaining space. WELCOME HOME!!
